sloka: राक्षसाश्चापि मुख्यास्ते रथेषु समवस्थिताः ।नानाप्रहरणाः शूराः प्रायुद्ध्यन्त तदा रणे ।। ६.५४.३ ।।।।
transliteration: rākṣasāścāpi mukhyāste ratheṣu samavasthitāḥ ।nānāpraharaṇāḥ śūrāḥ prāyuddhyanta tadā raṇe ।। 6.54.3 ।।।।

translations.english: Seated firmly on the chariots the chiefs and heroes of Rakshasas also fought steadily with different weapons in the combat.
